task_summary: Transcribe a 23-minute Blender tutorial video using Whisper and detect timestamps for 29 predefined chapter titles, outputting results as a structured JSON file.
decomposition_rationale: The task requires two distinct functional domains: (1) audio extraction and transcription via FFmpeg/Whisper, and (2) chapter timestamp detection via transcript analysis and fuzzy matching, followed by JSON output generation. These naturally separate into a transcription skill and a chapter detection/output skill.

skills.name: evo-audio-transcription
skills.description: Extracts audio from MP4 video files using FFmpeg and transcribes them using OpenAI Whisper with word-level timestamps. Provides utilities for audio preprocessing and robust transcription with hallucination mitigation.
skills.responsibility: Audio extraction from video containers (FFmpeg subprocess), Whisper model loading and transcription with optimal parameters (word_timestamps, condition_on_previous_text, language, no_speech_threshold), returning structured transcript data with word-level timestamps.
dr_sections: 1. Whisper Transcription API and Timestamp Mechanics
1.1 Loading the Model and Available Models
2. FFmpeg Audio Extraction from MP4 Containers
3. Whisper Segment Timestamp Accuracy and Alignment

skills.name: evo-chapter-detection
skills.description: Maps predefined chapter titles to timestamps in a Whisper transcript using sliding window fuzzy string matching, then generates the final structured JSON output with video metadata and chapter timestamps.
skills.responsibility: Fuzzy string matching of chapter titles against transcript words using sliding windows, enforcing monotonic ordering and boundary constraints, and writing the final tutorial_index.json output file in the required format.
dr_sections: 4. Text Matching and Chapter Detection Patterns
4.1 Fuzzy String Matching with Levenshtein Distance
4.2 The Sliding Window Algorithm over Transcript Segments
